opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: Look up a country on World Bank Open Data and Wikipedia, then compose an email to a given recipient with subject '<Country> macro snapshot' and a body summarizing GDP, growth, population, capital and currency.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data and type the country name in the search box
Select the country suggestion and read the overview (population, GDP, growth)
Open Wikipedia and search for the country
Open the country article and note the capital and currency
Open the New message compose form
Enter the recipient email in To
Type the body: 'Hi <name>, <Country>: GDP US$<gdp> billion (<year>), growth <g>%, population <pop> (<year>); capital <capital>, currency <currency> (<code>).'
Send the message, or discard it as the user did

opportunities.name: Log a Gutenberg book in reading notes
opportunities.description: Search Project Gutenberg for a book title, open its most popular edition, look up the author's dates on Wikipedia, and add a note 'Read: <title> by <author> (<dates>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads'.
steps: Open Project Gutenberg and type the book title in Quick search, then click Go
Open the top result by popularity
Read the release date and the 30-day download count from the bibliographic record
Open Wikipedia and search for the author's name to get their birth and death years
Open the Notes page and click the 'New note' field
Type 'Read: <title> by <author> (<birth>-<death>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads' and save
